verdict.rationale: The documented API only supports sending messages programmatically (poke-docs-1, poke-docs-2) and triggering via webhooks, while the UI offers many richer capabilities (integrations, recipes, memory, human-task dispatch, website creation, email address, multi-channel messaging) with no documented API equivalents; probes confirm no OpenAPI/swagger spec exists (poke-probe-3) and docs.md 404s (poke-probe-2). MCP support lets Poke consume external tools, not expose full UI functionality via API. missing for 10: OpenAPI/spec parity, API endpoints for integrations/recipes/memory management, evidence that all UI actions (website deploy, human tasks, channel management) are API-accessible.
